title: PRESIDENT OF INDIA PAYS FLORAL TRIBUTES TO DR. APJ ABDUL KALAM ON HIS BIRTH ANNIVERSARY
body_text:
The President of India, Smt Droupadi Murmu paid floral tributes to Dr. APJ Abdul Kalam, former President of India on his birth anniversary at Vijayawada, Andhra Pradesh today (October 15, 2026). The President is in Vijayawada to grace the National SARAS Mela.
